title: Artificial Intelligence Production Support
job_description: Join a leading financial institution to play a major part in digital transformation and innovation. As part of a growing AI & Innovation team, you will support advanced AI tools and platforms power analytics and automation. This is a unique opportunity to work in a large-scale, enterprise environment where stability, performance, and innovation go hand in hand. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability of modern, AI-driven systems, working closely with engineering teams and business stakeholders to support high-impact platforms used across the organisation. Key Responsibilities • Provide end-to-end application and production support for AI-driven platforms, ensuring high availability, performance, and reliability. • Monitor system health, troubleshoot incidents, and perform root cause analysis across applications, services, and data pipelines. • Support deployment activities and environment management, working closely with engineering teams to ensure smooth releases. • Investigate and resolve technical issues using logs, scripts, and system tools across distributed environments. • Collaborate with developers, data engineers, and business stakeholders to diagnose issues and implement sustainable solutions. • Participate in incident management processes, including escalation, tracking, and post-incident reviews. • Contribute to continuous improvement of support processes, including automation, monitoring enhancements, and system optimisation. • Maintain documentation, runbooks, and operational procedures to ensure effective knowledge sharing and support continuity. Requirements Must Have: • 5-10 years of experience in application support, production support, or IT support within a technology-driven environment. • Hands-on experience or exposure to: – Python (scripting, debugging, automation) and Linux / Unix systems (command line, log analysis, system operations). • Experience supporting enterprise applications, APIs, or data-driven systems. • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment. • Good communication skills, with the ability to interact with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Nice to Have: • Exposure to AI / machine learning platforms and/or data pipelines. • Experience in agentic AI / generative AI / RAG. • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g. Git-based pipelines, Jenkins or similar tools). • Experience working in cloud or hybrid environments. • Understanding of monitoring tools, system observability, or incident management practices. • Leadership experiences at working settings. • Prior experience in financial services or other regulated industries. Why Join: • Opportunity to support and learn from modern AI and data-driven platforms. • Exposure to large-scale, enterprise-grade systems and innovation initiatives. • Collaborative environment working with engineering, data, and business teams. • Strong career development path within technology and innovation functions.
